full_prompt_en: A square oil painting in an ornate eighteenth-century manner shows an elegantly dressed man and woman seated close together in a shaded garden, with a white lamb between them. The man occupies the left, looking outward with a faint reserved smile. A broad cream tricorne hat, curled pale wig, embroidered waistcoat, lace cravat, and warm gray-brown coat give his seated figure a layered, softly rumpled silhouette. His right hand rests low near straw and a basket of dark grapes or fruit at the lower left. The woman sits slightly higher at center-right, facing the viewer with a small composed smile. Her powdered hair rises in a high curled arrangement with pale blue bows and feathers. A low neckline, lace-trimmed sleeves, and a richly embroidered pale blue gown spread across the lower right, with gold and blush ornaments breaking up the cool fabric. Between their knees, the lamb's white face turns forward while its body sinks into a nest of yellow straw. Dark leafy foliage and warm earth colors fill the upper background, with only small passages of garden light visible between branches. A cluster of fruit and leaves sits near the lower edge, continuing the abundance around the pair. Paint is built in blended, supple strokes: satin, lace, wool, skin, and foliage each receive different degrees of softness and shine. Gentle light enters from the upper left, illuminating faces, lace, the lamb, and pale silk while deep olive-brown shadows hold the garden behind. The composition forms a close, interlocking group in a warm pastoral setting, balancing refined dress with a playful rural companion.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、带华丽十八世纪气息的油画中，一名衣着讲究的男子与女子在树荫花园里紧挨坐着，中间有只白色小羊。男子在左侧，望向画外，带克制的淡笑。宽大的奶油色三角帽、卷曲浅色假发、刺绣背心、蕾丝领巾和暖灰棕外衣，使他的坐姿轮廓层叠而柔软微皱。他的右手低垂在稻草与左下角一篮深色葡萄或果实附近。女子略高地坐在中右部，正视观者，带着安静的小笑。扑粉头发高高卷起，饰有浅蓝蝴蝶结与羽毛。低领、蕾丝边袖子和绣饰丰富的浅蓝礼服铺向右下方，金色与浅粉装饰打破冷色布面。二人膝间，小羊白色面孔朝前，身体陷在黄色草窝里。深色叶丛与暖土色填满上方背景，树枝间只露出少量花园亮处。果实与叶片簇在下缘，延续人物四周的丰盛感。油彩由融合而柔韧的笔触建立，缎面、蕾丝、羊毛、肌肤和树叶各有不同程度的柔软与光泽。柔光从左上进入，照亮面孔、蕾丝、小羊与浅色丝绸，深橄榄棕阴影托住背后花园。构图在温暖牧歌环境里组成紧密相扣的一群，让精致衣饰与顽皮乡间伙伴相平衡。
style_prompt_en: Ornate oil painting favors supple blended brushwork, warm skin tones, pale satin glints, filigree lace, and abundant soft foliage. Arrange several forms in an interlocking, gently curving group rather than rigid symmetry; let fabric and organic detail fill the lower edges while a dark leafy backdrop supports illuminated focal areas. Balance creamy ivory, powder blue, blush, muted gold, and olive-brown, placing cool finery against warm earth shadows. Diffuse light from one upper side caresses cheeks and reflective textiles, with deep transparent shadow behind and little hard contour. Distinguish wool, silk, skin, and leaves through varied paint handling. The resulting atmosphere is gracious, lush, playful, and quietly theatrical.
style_prompt_zh: 华丽油画偏用柔韧融合的笔触、温暖肤色、浅色缎面亮斑、丝缕般蕾丝和丰盛柔叶。数个形体以相扣的柔和曲线成组，而非僵硬对称；布料与有机细节填满下缘，深色叶丛衬托受光焦点。奶油白、粉蓝、浅绯、低饱和金与橄榄棕相平衡，让冷色华美材质对着暖土色暗影。单侧上方的漫射光轻抚面颊及反光纺织物，后方留深而通透的影，轮廓少用硬边。以不同油彩处理区分羊毛、丝绸、肌肤与叶面。整体气息优雅、繁盛、俏皮且带含蓄戏剧感。
theme_en: An elegant couple seated with a white lamb in a lush garden
theme_zh: 华服男女与白色小羊坐在繁茂花园中
name: Francois Boucher
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
